slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video, absolute inset-0 object-cover behind navbar and hero copy; autoplay, muted, playsInline.
32x32 angular geometric brand mark, single-fill, appears top-left in navbar and in the mobile sheet header; fill currently hardcoded to fg (#192837) inside inline SVG path.
Brand display/heading typeface used for the hero heading (var(--font-heading)); loaded from a swappable web-font CDN URL as a <link> in index.html. Native value is 'Helvetica Now Display Bold'.

mechanic: Fullscreen sticky hero with an object-cover looping background video and a left-aligned copy block whose heading, subtext, and CTA fade-up in sequence (y:28->0, staggered 0.15s), plus a right-side AnimatePresence slide-in mobile menu sheet.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + lucide-react, with the display web-font loaded via <link> in index.html and Inter imported in CSS.
reskinNotes: Logo color is baked as a hardcoded #192837 fill inside the inline SVG path (must be re-tokenized to swap with the brand mark). Heading inline icons (Zap, LockKeyhole, Fingerprint) are Lucide components positioned inside the headline string, so the headline copy slot is structurally coupled to icon placement rather than being free text. All copy (heading, subtext, nav labels, CTA labels) is hardcoded in markup. Display heading face is fetched from a third-party onlinewebfonts CDN URL that must be replaced for brand reskins.
